headline: What counts as a good night's sleep once you're somebody's mom
items: Four hours in a row, then awake before the alarm to check on them
Only up once, even if once lasted an hour
Asleep on the couch by 8:40, and calling it an early night
Waking up to find nobody needed you, for one whole stretch
turn: The bar moved. Some mornings, clearing it is the whole win.
